checks.name: dup_trim_per_ymm
checks.desc: same year/make/model/display_trim appears >1 (error if specs conflict, warn if identical)

checks.name: junk_trim_name
checks.desc: Front/Rear in trim (error); comma catch-all, trim==model (warn); Base/empty beside real trims (info)

checks.name: wheel_string_width_first
checks.desc: string wheel entries stored width-first (8x18 / 8Jx17)

checks.name: wheel_not_array
checks.desc: oem_wheel_sizes is a bare jsonb scalar (double-encoded JSON string)

checks.name: tire_not_array
checks.desc: oem_tire_sizes is a bare jsonb scalar (double-encoded JSON string)

checks.name: wheel_shape_nonstandard
checks.desc: oem_wheel_sizes shape other than obj:axle

checks.name: wheel_axle_front_only
checks.desc: every wheel entry is axle:'front' with no rear/both — square fitment mislabelled; fitment-search filters axle=='both' so these resolve as staggered-with-no-rear

checks.name: wheel_object_stringified
checks.desc: wheel entries are the literal string '[object Object]' — data destroyed at import, unrecoverable

checks.name: wheel_unparseable
checks.desc: wheel entries the canonical converter cannot convert (or all entries dropped)

checks.name: wheel_dims_implausible
checks.desc: wheel width outside 3..14 in, width null/missing, diameter-only entry, or width range string

checks.name: wheel_mixed_types
checks.desc: oem_wheel_sizes array mixes strings and objects

checks.name: wheel_dropped_keys
checks.desc: wheel entries carry per-entry notes/trim that the canonical shape cannot hold (needs trim split)

checks.name: tire_unparseable
checks.desc: tire size strings with no recognizable rim diameter

checks.name: tire_double_encoded
checks.desc: tire array elements that are themselves JSON-encoded arrays

checks.name: tire_axle_suffix
checks.desc: staggered tires encoded as '245/40R19 front' strings inside a flat array

checks.name: tire_rim_mismatch
checks.desc: tire rim diameter with no matching OEM wheel diameter (error if none match, warn if partial)

checks.name: empty_bolt_pattern
checks.desc: bolt_pattern null/empty

checks.name: bolt_pattern_malformed
checks.desc: bolt_pattern not ^\d+x\d+(\.\d+)?$

checks.name: bolt_or_cb_changes_within_run
checks.desc: consecutive model-years where the set of bolt/CB values changes (info: Pass 3 reviews)

checks.name: offset_out_of_range
checks.desc: offset_min < -80 or offset_max > 75 or min > max (info for HD 8-lug / DRW where +130 is real)

checks.name: cb_implausible
checks.desc: center bore outside the plausible range for the bolt pattern family

checks.name: deprecated_source_active
checks.desc: source LIKE 'deprecated%' but not quarantined

checks.name: cert_status_non_certified_active
checks.desc: active rows the site will never serve (certification_status <> certified) — quarantine or fix

checks.name: make_slug_variant
checks.desc: make slug variants: 'mercedes' vs 'mercedes-benz', '<make> vans/minivans'

checks.name: phantom_year_hint
checks.desc: year out of 1940..2026 (error); model-year with no sibling year within ±3 (info)

checks.name: missing_core_fields
checks.desc: null/empty thread_size, seat_type, center_bore, tires or wheels

checks.name: staggered_inconsistent
checks.desc: tires {front,rear} but wheels all square (warn); wheels front/rear but tires flat (info)

checks.name: thread_size_nonstandard
checks.desc: thread_size not in canonical form (M12x1.5 | M14x1.5 | 1/2-20 …): spaces, trailing B, .50

checks.name: seat_type_nonstandard
checks.desc: seat_type not in (conical, ball, flat)
